title: Measuring Household Food Usage after a Rise on a Shared Tailwise Autoship
content:
When the household's usage of a shared household food Autoship under Tailwise Autoship (a non-prescription food subscription that feeds more than one pet of the household) rose in the last six months, the household's current usage is measured on its new footing.

## When usage rose

The usage rose when scheduled shipments were charged both in the last six months and between six and twelve months ago, and the average units per scheduled shipment charged in the last six months exceed the average units per scheduled shipment charged between six and twelve months ago. It did not rise when either period has no scheduled shipment.

A record counts as dated in the last N months when its date is later than the same calendar day N months before the day the value is worked out, so a record dated exactly N months earlier does not count; a record dated between six and twelve months ago is one dated in the last twelve months but not in the last six months.

## Measure of current usage

| Usage rose | Latest scheduled shipment charged carried the units per shipment the subscription holds now | Current usage |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | The units that latest scheduled shipment carried, divided by the weeks it was booked to cover: the days from its charge date to the subscription's next ship date, divided by 7 |
| Yes | No (a different number of units) | The units of scheduled shipments charged in the last six months, divided by 26 weeks |
| No | — | Not re-measured on a new footing |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- Average of 2 units per scheduled shipment between six and twelve months ago, 3 in the last six months: usage rose. The latest scheduled shipment carried 3 units, the subscription holds 3 now, it was charged 21 days before the next ship date: 21 divided by 7 is 3 weeks, and current usage is 3 divided by 3, that is 1 unit a week.
- Same rise, but the subscription now holds 4 units per shipment while the latest scheduled shipment carried 3: 39 units charged on scheduled shipments in the last six months give 39 divided by 26, that is 1.5 units a week.
- No scheduled shipment charged between six and twelve months ago: usage did not rise.
- Equal averages in both periods: usage did not rise.
